title: Bronze to Silver that survives a rerun
objectives: Type raw text columns and drop rows that can't be read
Keep the newest version of each order
Build the table so running it again gives the same table

exercises.prompt: Build silver_orders from bronze_orders: order_id INTEGER, order_date DATE and amount DECIMAL(12, 2), one row per order (the most recently ingested), without rows whose order_date isn't a date. It must give the same table if run twice. End with SELECT order_id, order_date, amount FROM silver_orders ORDER BY order_id.
hints: The starter copies Bronze as it is: text columns, a bad date, and orders 2 and 4 twice.
TRY_CAST(order_date AS DATE) IS NOT NULL drops the bad row. row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY ingested_at DESC) = 1 keeps the newest version.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_orders AS SELECT ... rebuilds the table from Bronze each time, so a rerun can't double anything.
